content.title: WWE NXT Stand & Deliver Stream & Results (4/4/2026) - Fightful | WWE News, AEW News, Pro Wrestling Backstage News
content.text: Full results for WWE NXT Stand & Deliver on YouTube & Netflix on April 4, 2026, live from The Factory in St. Louis, Missouri. On March 31, 2026, World Wrestling Entertainment hosted NXT Stand & Deliver on YouTube & Netflix live from the Performance Center in Orlando, Florida. Jacy Jayne vs. Lola Vice vs. Kendal Grey headlined the show. The full results are listed below Refresh the site for the latest updates as the show happens. WWE NXT Stand & Deliver (4/4/2026). WWE NXT North American Championship: Myles Borne (c) vs. Johnny Gargano. Sol Ruca vs. Zaria. WWE NXT Championship: Joe Hendry (c) vs. Ricky Saints vs. Ethan Page vs. Tony D’Angelo. WWE NXT Women’s Championship: Jacy Jayne (c) vs. Lola Vice vs. Kendal Grey. WWE NXT Tag Team Championships: The Vanity Project (Brad Baylor and Ricky Smokes) (c) vs. Los Americanos (Bravo Americano and Rayo Americano). WWE NXT Women’s North American Championship: Tatum Paxley (c) vs. Blake Monroe. Pre-Show Match: Hank and Tank (Hank Walker and Tank Ledger), Shiloh Hill, EK Prosper & Wren Sinclair vs. Birth Right (Lexis King, Channing “Stacks” Lorenzo, Charlie Dempsey, Uriah Connors, and Arianna Grace). Live Coverage. Pre-Show Match: Hank and Tank (Hank Walker and Tank Ledger), Shiloh Hill, EK Prosper & Wren Sinclair vs. Birth Right (Lexis King, Channing “Stacks” Lorenzo, Charlie Dempsey, Uriah Connors, and Arianna Grace). Shawn Michaels & Sexxy Red kicked of the show. WWE NXT Women’s Championship: Lola Vice def. Jacy Jayne (c) & Kendal Grey. Kali Armstrong is coming to NXT. WWE NXT Tag Team Championships: The Vanity Project (Brad Baylor and Ricky Smokes) (c) (w/ Jackson Drake) vs. Los Americanos (Bravo Americano and Rayo Americano) (w/ El Grance Americano) to retain the title. Shiloh Hill was hyped about winning his WWE PLE debut. Hill spoke with Tatum Paxley, telling her she would win tonight. Sexxy Red appeared, but Ricky Saints showed up and told Red she needed to hang out with him instead. Sol Ruca def. ZARIA. Robert Stone congratulated Lola Vice for winning the title & announced she would have a celebration on NXT. Vice & Sexxy Red then celebrated. WWE NXT North American Championship: Myles Borne (c) def. Johnny Gargano (w/ Candice LeRae) to retain the title. Dion Lennox attacked Borne after the match. Sol Ruca was confronted backstage by Izzi Dame. Dmae vs. Ruca was made official for NXT. WWE NXT Women’s North American Championship: Tatum Paxley (c) def. Blake Monroe to retain the title. Dion Lennox met with DarkState (Saquon Shugars, Osiris Griffin & Cutler James) backstage. Darkstate took offense when Lennox attacked Borne without them knowing. Lennox said he had a plan for everyone to eat. Keanu Carver called out Josh Briggs & Jasper Troy. WWE NXT Championship: Tony D’Angelo def. Joe Hendry (c), Ricky Saints & Ethan Page to win the title. – Check out the post-show podcast for a full review of the show on Fightful’s YouTube & Twitch channels.
